div.div:
Tiers are checked TOP-TO-BOTTOM and are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE — each later tier runs only if sideway_selected[0]==0 (no earlier match). First match wins.
This is a CLASSIFIER: the output is a code, never a trade. Trading value of any code is UNTESTED.
val{i}=sideway_val[i]. Line numbers refer to TofySideway.mqh.
